title: Budget and nutrition boundaries
steps: Submit budgets 29.99, 30, 10000, 10000.01; submit calorie goals 1199, 1200, 4500 and 4501. Reload after each.
expected: Only the documented budget range 30-10000 and integer calorie range 1200-4500 save; failures leave saved answers unchanged.

title: Preference note lengths
steps: Type/paste 500 characters into the preference note and save. Use browser developer tools to remove maxlength, submit 501 characters, then reload.
expected: 500 characters save; 501 returns an inline field error; previous note remains intact.

title: Complete weekly availability and diet state
steps: Set different minutes for each of seven days, select vegan and nut allergy, save and reload; clear both checkboxes and save again.
expected: All seven weekdays retain the correct values in order; clearing restrictions explicitly clears both; optional sections remain skippable.

title: Reject rounding and unknown restrictions
steps: Using browser network tools or an HTTP client, submit minutes_0=15.9, calorie_target=1200.9, and restrictions=made_up with restrictions_present=1, one at a time. Then submit the note I only eat chicken and generate.
expected: Invalid numeric formats and unknown choices show errors rather than truncation or silent removal. The readback enforces chicken-only meat; generated catalog ingredients contain no other meat or seafood.

title: Pantry quantities
steps: Add rice with quantity 0, then 1000000, then 1000001, then NaN using developer tools. Reload after each attempt.
expected: Zero and the maximum finite quantity save; over-limit/nonfinite inputs are rejected without changing stock.

title: Pantry name, unit and entry caps
steps: Try names of 100/101 characters, units of 20/21 characters, and a 201st distinct pantry entry after reaching 200. Existing entries may still be updated.
expected: Maximum-length names/units save; longer values and a new 201st entry are refused, never silently truncated. Updating an existing entry still works.

title: Minimal onboarding and full-week structure
steps: For a new account, enter only a valid budget, leave optional diet/goal/notes/pantry blank, finish the wizard, and open every day and a full recipe. Record onboarding duration separately if a human performs it.
expected: Seven days have breakfast/lunch/dinner (21 slots), with ingredient quantities and preparation steps. No optional answer is required. The three-minute human setup criterion is NOT inferred from software timing.

title: Malformed provider payload
steps: In a developer test session, use tests.test_plan.Scripted as a dependency override to return meals as a string, a blank recipe name, 22 meals, 31 steps, or 51 ingredients; request generation for each. Do not add a production debug endpoint.
expected: The schema rejects malformed/oversized responses, bounded retries show a useful error, and the last valid plan remains available.

title: Pantry-aware spending
steps: Generate with no pantry, record the package estimate, then add enough matching-unit pantry stock to cover ingredients and regenerate using the same saved requirements. Also try a budget below all known recipe portions using a developer fixture.
expected: Both remaining-portion and whole-package costs are checked after pantry deductions; owned food is not charged again. Failure explains a budget issue or failed search without claiming all possible menus are impossible.

title: Bounded validation failures
steps: Return an invalid developer fixture with many malformed meals or missing fields; generate and inspect the message and browser cookies.
expected: Error output is bounded to the schema error limit; no giant error/stack trace or corrupted session cookie; old plan is preserved.

title: Calendar and cost reconciliation
steps: Generate a full week, open the calendar and meal details, and inspect grocery rows. Manually total a sample meal ingredient cost and the displayed package basket.
expected: The calendar has seven days and three required meal slots per day. Per-meal portions and weekly package cost are separately labeled; each matches its underlying ingredients/packages.

title: Diet restrictions and literal requests
steps: Select vegan plus nut allergy; generate. Repeat with No red meat and I only eat chicken. Inspect every ingredient and restriction readback; do not infer product-label allergen safety.
expected: Catalog ingredient/name matching honors all recognized exclusions. Unsupported text is flagged for review. Ingredient overlap is consolidated; no unsafe plan is labeled fully checked.

title: Late and zero-minute cooking
steps: Set Wednesday minutes to 0 and select Sunday preparation. Enter meal times 06:00/13:00/22:00 and valid cooking windows; generate and inspect assignments and calendar bounds.
expected: No active cooking exceeds a daily capacity or misses a deadline. Early/late/outside events fit the grid. Unmet soft goals/time requirements remain visible as Needs review.

title: Cooking-window count
steps: Submit eight valid nonoverlapping windows for one day, then nine windows or a field longer than 127 characters.
expected: At most eight windows are accepted; oversized/count-over-limit input returns 400 and does not replace the saved schedule.

title: Skip, restore, pin and regenerate
steps: Pin a future meal, skip an unused future day, regenerate, restore that day and regenerate again. Open a recipe and return to the calendar. Close the plan via check-in and try pinning an old meal.
expected: The pin stays identical; skipped slots and groceries disappear; restored slots return after regeneration; detail links work. Closed-plan pin controls are absent and a direct pin request returns 409.

title: Strict clock syntax
steps: Try 7:00, 07:0, 24:00, 12:60, overlapping/reversed windows and valid 00:00/23:59 endpoints.
expected: Only HH:MM clocks with valid hours/minutes and ordered, nonoverlapping windows save. Invalid submissions preserve prior values.

title: Partial and full pantry deductions
steps: For a grocery ingredient, record its required quantity N; add N-1, N, and N+1 in matching units, and then try the same number in a different unit.
expected: The list shows only the shortfall, drops fully covered items, and never converts unrelated units. Estimated costs adjust with the shortfall.

title: Repeated ingredient consolidation
steps: Generate a week with repeated recipes; inspect the grocery list after a single-meal swap and a regeneration with pins.
expected: Each normalized name/unit combination appears once; quantities sum all active meal requirements without duplicate rows or stale swapped ingredients.

title: Sections, snapshots and swap isolation
steps: Capture the week, pin one meal and swap another. Compare all other meal names, amounts, steps and slots. Review each grocery section and current verification panel.
expected: Only the requested meal changes; pins remain byte-for-byte equivalent in normalized recipe content; the complete plan is revalidated and each grocery item appears in exactly one store section.

title: Canonical ingredient units and adversarial revalidation
steps: Use a developer fixture containing RICE / CUP and rice / cup. Then return a fixture with one duplicate slot and one missing slot on regeneration.
expected: Names/units consolidate canonically; duplicate/missing coverage is rejected and the last valid plan is not overwritten.

title: Ratings and state transitions
steps: Try ratings 0, 1, 5 and 6; mark a cooked/rated meal planned or skipped, and inspect later rating preferences.
expected: Only 1-5 ratings on cooked meals save. Resetting/skipping clears the old rating so it no longer biases future plans. Closed inventory cannot be edited through status endpoints.

title: Check-in notes and shopping handoff limits
steps: Save 500-character check-in notes, undo check-in, then try 501. In an isolated fixture, attempt a shopping payload with 201 lines.
expected: Long notes are rejected without closing/settling the plan; shopping payloads above 200 lines are rejected without sending to the provider.

title: Grocery persistence, weekly learning and inventory
steps: Check/uncheck groceries and reload; force a network save failure and confirm rollback. Cook and rate meals, submit a check-in with leftovers and less cooking time, then generate next week. On a disposable account, exercise Send to Instacart both without a key and with a development key.
expected: Check state persists; failed saves roll back. Settlement happens once, leftovers carry into pantry, and next-week choices reflect ratings/notes/time. Missing-key handoff is clear; with a valid key, unchecked items open an Instacart list for review, never an automatic order.

title: Check-in choices and provider response
steps: Submit unknown overall/cook_time/variety values. With a developer transport fixture, return timeout, 401, malformed JSON or a non-Instacart shopping URL.
expected: Invalid choices return 422 without changing inventory. Provider errors use safe messages, never leak API keys and never redirect to an untrusted host.
